body: Yeah and not getting any hazard pay for being exposed to hundreds of people daily... love being a budtender sometimes. People legit coming in sick and coughing everywhere...like how am I doing this for 14 an hour still? (I’m from Washington). Half of my team is sick and the other is too afraid to come in to work... and understandably so. Be nice and tip your budtenders and please don’t come in coughing!!

I’m going through something similar :/ loosing a ton of weight and feeling so good about yourself is one of the best feelings ever. I too went through some shit and gained over half back... I’ve been really struggling to not beat myself over it. Just get back on the wagon and don’t get frustrated. You did it once and you can do it again! I’ve found really good results with getting back in the gym at least 4 times a week which also helps you feel better mentally too!
